notes: Card + pole: ' language' x13 (mostly 'English language'), 語 in C言語 and 他の言語; - pole is 語 in 英語. Probe: C言語 1.02, 'English language courses' 0.52, 'The English language' 0.47, 'body language' 0.09, 'programming language' 0.04, English literature 0.03, 'second tongue' 0.05. Near misses drop the language word; one Japanese near miss uses 英語/フランス語 (same 語 token, opposite pole's context).
